main_text.p: quam eorum quorum interest Principum suffragatio huc accesserit, recte equidem fecisti & prudenter, quod huc è Dania non redieris: frustra enim ad incertum casum laborem & sumptum impendisses, & quid adventus tuus, ad promovendam deliberationis usque adeo late diffusae celeritatem profuturus fuisset, non videmus. Bene vale & nos tibi benigne cupere confidas.
main_text.head: AUGUSTUS

page.notes: Scan is partly obscured by specks and stains in the lower half; the numeral "LXIV." at lower right is partly damaged and read with some doubt. The word "Dania" in the line "quod huc è Dania" is partly damaged in the scan and may read differently. The word "Principum" is partly cut off at the line end.
